subject: Declared source-text scanner suites that a CI invocation already reaches on main, in breach of the inherited rule that a source-text scanner is never wired into CI.
rule: T-550's rule as T-556 narrowed it, quoted from docs/architecture/t492-stale-suite-triage.json: "a source-text scanner is never wired into CI, and one whose subject genuinely IS the text says so in writing and is still not wired".
howMeasured: The census's own resolver — collectReachableCommands + reachableEntrySelects from scripts/quality/test-ci-coverage-census.mjs — not a grep of .github/workflows. Neither of these two is named by any workflow run: line, which is why a literal workflow match reports zero and this list is not empty.
closedAndShrinking: This list may only shrink. The companion suite asserts set EQUALITY, so a third breach fails it, and an entry whose suite has been rewritten or withdrawn from CI must be deleted in the same change. It is a ratchet, in the idiom of product-directory-ci-coverage.baseline.json, and never an allowlist to append to.

entries.note: Six cases, all regexes over the route's source read at module load. T-481 owns the rewrite. Closing this entry means the rewrite landed, not that the path was removed from this file.
Eighty-eight cases, every one a regex over five files read at module load, and the largest scanner in the T-479 draw. T-481 owns the rewrite.
